title: Translation Of Extracts From The Count De Toulouse Lautrec De Savines Book

page_data.en:
TRANSLATION OF EXTRACTS FROM THE
COUNT DE TOULOUSE LAUTREC DE
SAVINE'S BOOK.
（批：9.pel. 1h / 2r 4 / 9 3/8）

Russia and Russian people will retaliate on the Bri-
tish Authorities some day for all the evil and injury done
by these haughty brutes to her and her people. "Oh If only I
could go to Petrograd to Lenin and Trotsky, I would probably
persuade them to arrange an expedition to India in order to
release its many millions of population from the yoke of slave-
ry and exploitation of such a monarchical and bourgeois England!
The Russian people will of course be the best means of bolshe-
vist propaganda! What a blow would be dealt to these English
monarchists and bourgeois! And at the same time what a victory
of socialism over the black powers of rectionary bourgeois of
all Countries and all shades! Let us remember what big propagan-
da of revolutionary ideas was carried by the French army to the
whole of Europe in the end of XVII century! Besides Soviet Rus-
sia will have the sympathy and substantial assistance of the
whole Mahomedan world, which will join the Russian people in
order to release the Mussulman population of India from the
yoke of the English. The English are hated by the whole world!
And the inhabitants of India simply curse them!... India and
its population on whom they have imposed their authority, the
English rule, their King, King George with the Imperial title
and crown of India and in addition are trying to impose their
religion, Christianity and their Church with their God-Jesus
Christ. Thousands of idle Missionaries are engaged in this work
who are subsidied by the wealthy bourgeoisie of England, who ima-
gines that it does a great and good work by sending out Missio-
naries. These have to be driven away first of all.
The Campaign in India will also find great sympathy in
Afghanistan so warlike and very hostile to England, with its
page_data.zh:
图卢兹-洛特雷克·德·萨维纳伯爵（Count de Toulouse Lautrec de Savine）著作摘录译文。
（批注：9.pel. 1h / 2r 4 / 9 3/8）

俄罗斯和俄罗斯人民总有一天会对英国当局进行报复，以雪这些傲慢的畜生对她及其人民所犯下的种种罪恶和伤害。“噢，如果我能去彼得格勒见列宁和托洛茨基，我可能会说服他们安排一次远征印度的行动，以便将印度数以百万计的人口从君主制和资产阶级英国的奴隶枷锁和剥削中解放出来！俄罗斯人民当然将是布尔什维克宣传的最佳手段！这对那些英国君主主义者和资产阶级将是多么沉重的打击！同时，这也是社会主义对所有国家、各种派别的反动资产阶级黑暗势力的胜利！让我们记住，在十七世纪末，法国军队曾向整个欧洲传播了多么巨大的革命思想宣传！此外，苏维埃俄罗斯还将获得整个穆斯林世界的同情和实质性援助，他们将加入俄罗斯人民的行列，以将印度的穆斯林人口从英国的枷锁中解放出来。全世界都憎恨英国人！而印度居民简直是在诅咒他们！……印度及其被强加权威的人口，即英国的统治、他们的国王乔治以及印度的帝国头衔和王冠，此外他们还试图强加他们的宗教——基督教及其教会和他们的上帝耶稣基督。成千上万无所事事的传教士从事着这项工作，他们由英国富有的资产阶级资助，后者认为派遣传教士是一项伟大而有益的工作。首先必须赶走这些人。
在印度的军事行动也会在阿富汗得到极大的同情，阿富汗好战且对英国非常敌视，其

page_data.en:

brave population and wise Emir Abdul Rahman who had his mili-
tary instruction in Russia, Russia which he respectes and likes
----------------
The Count was sorry that the English warders,who were
so anxious about Chinese civilization,did not teach them their
British reticence and quietude which would stop their chatter,
and would educate and discipline the Chinese far better than
the Bible which is given them in Chinese on their arrival in
prison. As regards the Prison itself in general, it and its
prison system are far from being modern or perfect. And exami-
ning this question scientifically and impartially we must ad-
mit and get convinced that prison with its penal system has
done and is continuing to do only injury to humanity... Prison
is the hearth of idleness and school of crime. And police and
judicials (that is court authorities) are nothing
more but providers of prisons, who support other idlers, the
warders, shepherds of human flock and even worse than that,
executioners. Executioners in the full meaning of this word
because the warders, Englishmen who consider themselves the
most advanced and civilized nation of the world are not asha-
med and do not blush to beat (with a leather belt) the poor
Chinese, in the Shanghai prison, whose rule of the Shanghai
Municipal Jail for 1919 allows corporal penalty up to twelve
strikes with a leather strap for discipline offenses of
the prisoners, and there is no exception for the European pri-
soners which remains an open question for discussion and deci-
sion of the Chief of Prison, the so called Commissioner who
visits the Prison daily.
But in practice owing to strict, but very tactful,
just and undoubtedly human Head jailer, Mr. Weatherhead the
Chinese prisoners are very well off, being well fed and given
very little work to do, consisting only of cleaning the prison
and court yard.
Europeans are kept one in a cell and have good bedding
and food.
----------------

- 2 -

英勇的人民和睿智的埃米尔阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼（Abdul Rahman）曾在俄罗斯接受过军事训练，他尊重并喜欢俄罗斯
----------------
伯爵感到遗憾的是，那些如此关心中国文明的英国狱卒，并没有教导他们英国人的缄默和安静，这本来可以制止他们的喋喋不休，并且比在他们入狱时发给他们的中文版《圣经》能更好地教育和约束中国人。至于监狱本身及其监狱制度，远非现代或完美。科学且公正地审视这个问题，我们必须承认并确信，监狱及其刑罚制度过去和现在都只是在伤害人类……监狱是懒惰的温床和犯罪的学校。而警察和司法人员（即法院当局）不过是监狱的供应者，他们供养着其他闲人——狱卒，这群人类牧群的牧羊人，甚至更糟，是刽子手。在这个词的全部意义上他们是刽子手，因为那些自认为是世界上最先进、最文明民族的英国人狱卒，在上海监狱里毫不羞愧、面不改色地殴打（用皮带）可怜的中国人，根据1919年上海公共租界工部局警务处监狱规则，对于违反纪律的囚犯允许处以最多十二下皮带鞭打的体罚，而且欧洲囚犯也不例外，这仍然是一个有待监狱长（即所谓的专员，他每天视察监狱）讨论和决定的开放性问题。
但在实践中，由于严格但非常得体、公正且无疑充满人道精神的典狱长韦瑟黑德（Weatherhead）先生，中国囚犯的处境非常好，食物充足，工作量很少，仅包括打扫监狱和庭院。
欧洲人被单独关押在牢房中，拥有良好的寝具和食物。
----------------

page_data.en:
- 3 -

It was easier to carry our Russian chains than English
small chains. One could forget in Russian prison temporarily
that you are in a prison... but never in the English! You could
get all you want in the Russian prison by having a little
money and friends, but you can get nothing in the English pri-
son if you have a million dollars!.. And this because a Rus-
sian possesses a heart and soul and the Englishman's soul is
business and duty which is most important for him!..

But the enslaved and oppressed, by the English, Indi-
ans who are not Christians, but Buddhists, who perform the
duties of jailers and guards in the Shanghai Anglo-Chinese Pri-
son and on whom the British look haughtily,having numbered
them as prisoners and calling them by these numbers, have far
more soul and heart than Christians Britishers believing in
Jesus Christ. Though they do not know Jesus Christ in the Bible
they are far more human than those who read the Bible and be-
lieve in Christ-God.
------------

Mr. Weatherhead told the Count that the latter was
imprisoned by the Devil, which words surprised the Count and
thinking over these words,as he actually did not believe in the
existence of any real Devil, the Count concluded that Grosse
and Ivanoff constituted the Devils who imprisoned him together
with small devils Efimchuk, Merzaviantz, the police agents
Reeves and Shmidt, and Chinese judges of the Mixed Court. Cer-
tainly all these are devils who bear the ensign of their mas-
ter, the Evil Spirit being his adherents in his dark and hi-
deous affair... of human tyranny. The Count wished to ask Mr.
Weatherhead the following question: How could he, who believes
in God and is a true son of Christ's Church have received Count
in the prison in his charge and keeps him there by order and
will of the Devil??? It means he serves the Devil? and because
the establishment in his charge belongs to the Spirit of Dark-
ness, the Spirit of Evil, the Spirit of revenge and punishment?
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

携带俄罗斯的镣铐比携带英国的小镣铐更容易。在俄罗斯监狱里，人们可以暂时忘记自己身在狱中……但在英国监狱里绝不可能！在俄罗斯监狱里，只要有一点钱和朋友，你可以得到你想要的一切，但在英国监狱里，即使你有百万美元也一无所获！……这是因为俄罗斯人拥有心灵和灵魂，而英国人的灵魂是生意和责任，这对他们来说是最重要的！……

但是，在上海英华监狱中担任狱卒和看守的印度人，他们被英国人奴役和压迫，不是基督徒而是佛教徒，英国人傲慢地看待他们，将他们编号为囚犯并用这些号码称呼他们，然而他们比信奉耶稣基督的英国基督徒拥有更多的心灵和灵魂。虽然他们不知道《圣经》中的耶稣基督，但他们比那些阅读《圣经》并信奉基督上帝的人更具人性。
------------

韦瑟黑德先生告诉伯爵，他是被魔鬼囚禁的，这话让伯爵感到惊讶。伯爵思考着这些话，因为他实际上并不相信任何真实魔鬼的存在，他得出结论认为，格罗斯（Grosse）和伊万诺夫（Ivanoff）构成了囚禁他的魔鬼，连同小魔鬼叶菲姆丘克（Efimchuk）、梅尔扎维安茨（Merzaviantz）、警察代理人里夫斯（Reeves）和施密特（Shmidt），以及混合法庭的中国法官。当然，所有这些都是魔鬼，他们打着其主人——邪恶精神的旗帜，是其黑暗和丑陋事业……即人类暴政的追随者。伯爵本想问韦瑟黑德先生以下问题：作为一个信仰上帝且是基督教会真正儿子的人，他怎么能在他负责的监狱里接待伯爵，并根据魔鬼的命令和意志将他关押在那里？？？这意味着他在为魔鬼服务？因为他所管理的机构属于黑暗精神、邪恶精神、复仇和惩罚的精神？

page_data.en:
- 4 -

Perhaps it is a Shanghai Branch of the Hell?"But having thought
it over the Count refrained from posing such a question, being
afraid that he may be submitted to repressions in this Devil's
kingdom for frivolous thoughts and will forbid the Count to
write his book with such frivolous spirit as unbelief in the
Devil!

--------------

Now I shall give a description of the Shanghai Mu-
nicipal Anglo-Chinese prison, which will be interesting as
the English who have built it, direct it, of course for Chi-
nese money, with English rules, English stick and English
Bible in the hands of English sergeant-majors among whom there
are many swindlers (booms) from vicinity and large titles in-
cluding the Waichapoo (?) boys, whom Great Britain, the so
anxious Native Land for her sons, rewards with comfortable
places and quite secure life with money from the same Chinese
who are protected by the English, in such a rich and bourgeois
town as Shanghai!

Under the pretext and ensign of civilization, instruc-
tion and good order of Shanghai, the town is governed by the
Municipal Council which is wholly in the hands of the English,
owing to which fact both the Shanghai Police and the Municipal
Jail are exclusively in the hands of the English, who are
well paid with Chinese money. And the cadre of lower ranks,
the policemen and prison guards are though not English, but
still English subjects, Natives of India, all former soldiers
of the English army to whom the English rulers of rich India
give these jobs and sufficient pay in the Chinese cities Shang
hai and Tientsin, paying them with Chinese money but not their
own. Having imposed on China this their "British civilization"
they are such anxious protectors of the Chinese that they
pitilessly catch and imprison oppressed and rightless
citizens of the Celestial Empire into their upto date prison,
built similar to English prisons; and for the sake of civili-
zation mercilessly cut off the Chinese prisoners' tresses,
page_data.zh:
- 4 -

也许这是地狱的上海分署？”但经过深思熟虑，伯爵克制住没有提出这样的问题，因为他担心在这个魔鬼王国里，他会因轻浮的思想而受到镇压，并且会被禁止以这种不信任魔鬼的轻浮精神来撰写他的书！

--------------

现在我将描述上海公共租界英华监狱，这将很有趣，因为建造它、管理它的英国人，当然是用中国人的钱，执行英国的规则，在英国巡佐手中拿着英国的棍棒和英国的《圣经》，其中有许多来自附近的骗子（booms）和大人物，包括外白渡桥（Waichapoo (?)）的小伙子们，大不列颠这个如此关心其子民的祖国，用受英国保护的、在上海这样富裕且资产阶级化的城市里的中国人的钱，奖励他们舒适的职位和相当安全的生活！

以上海文明、教化及良好秩序为借口和旗帜，该市由完全掌握在英国人手中的工部局治理，因此上海警察和公共租界监狱也完全掌握在英国人手中，他们用中国人的钱领取高薪。而下级职员队伍，即警察和监狱看守，虽然不是英国人，但仍是英国臣民，即印度本地人，全是前英军士兵，富裕印度的英国统治者在中国城市上海和天津给他们提供这些工作和足够的薪水，用中国人的钱支付，而不是用他们自己的钱。将这种“英国文明”强加给中国后，他们成为中国人如此热心的保护者，以至于无情地抓捕并将天朝无助和无权的公民关进他们现代化的监狱，该监狱仿照英国监狱建造；为了文明，他们无情地剪掉中国囚犯的辫子，

dress them into numbered clothes and give the Bible in Chinese
to read for instruction and enlightenment. At the same time
at the least violation of prison discipline or smallest diso-
bedience they, these citizens of the Chinese Republic, are
whipped pitilessly with a leather whip or a stick of the Eng-
lish policeman with which all Indian jailers are provided. This
is not at all according to the Bible and its teaching!
----------------
For the purpose of Missionary work, the propaganda
of Bible the "civilizers of China" have probably built this
huge Shanghai Municipal prison on the Chinese land and Chinese
money, where up to two thousand Chinese, masters of the Count-
ry are kept in custody and slavery, under the stick of English
sergeant-majors (English loafers) and with the only permission
to read the Bible, good old English book (Sic!) The result
from consumption prevails
being that a large percent of deaths up to insanity which hard-
ly exists in the ordinary life of Chinese. But staying in
strange and abnormal atmosphere for them of the up to date
English prison with Chinese Bible in the hands, they become
insane and decay similarly to poor monkeys in Zoological Gar-
dens.
----------------
The Chinese prisoners' chatter ceases immediately
they hear footsteps of the English jailer visiting the cells
and recommence it again as soon as he goes. It is surprising
how Chinese are afraid of the English! They probably know that
they cannot joke with this nation, with these persons, so indif-
ferent, just, straight in everything and quiet at sight...And
at the least violation of the rules and discipline of the pri-
son nobody will make ceremony with them, the Chinese. Owing
to this they avoid in every way any trouble with foreign men,
as they call the English. Who are, by the way, also disliked
and feared by the Indian warders. While the Chinese behave
themselves quite well with the Indian warders notwithstanding
that the latter pitilessly beat them with the leather whip
page_data.zh:
- 5 -
给他们穿上编号的衣服，并发给中文版《圣经》以供阅读，作为教化和启蒙。同时，只要稍微违反监狱纪律或稍有不服从，这些中华民国公民就会遭到无情的鞭打，使用的是英国警察提供的皮鞭或棍棒，所有印度狱卒都配备有这些工具。这根本不符合《圣经》及其教义！
----------------
为了传教工作，宣传《圣经》，这些“中国的文明开化者”可能是在中国土地上、用中国人的钱建造了这座巨大的上海公共租界监狱，在这里，多达两千名这个国家的主人在英国巡佐（英国懒汉）的棍棒下被拘留和奴役，唯一的许可是阅读《圣经》，这本好的老英国书（原文如此！）。结果是死亡率很高，甚至出现疯狂，这在中国人的日常生活中几乎不存在。但是，身处对他们来说陌生且不正常的现代化英国监狱氛围中，手里拿着中文《圣经》，他们变得疯狂并衰败，就像动物园里可怜的猴子一样。
----------------
中国囚犯的喋喋不休在听到英国狱卒巡视牢房的脚步声时会立即停止，并在狱卒离开后立即重新开始。令人惊讶的是中国人是多么害怕英国人！他们可能知道不能与这个民族、这些人开玩笑，他们在各方面都如此冷漠、公正、直率且外表安静……一旦稍微违反监狱的规则和纪律，没有人会对他们这些中国人客气。因此，他们千方百计避免与外国人（他们这样称呼英国人）发生任何麻烦。顺便说一句，印度狱卒也不喜欢并害怕英国人。而中国人与印度狱卒相处得相当好，尽管后者无情地用皮鞭殴打他们

and pull by their ears!... But they say, masky, these are our
own Asiatic people, who also dislike and are afraid of the
English masters, Dominators of India, dominators of China too...
As regards Shanghai, the English are certainly masters of it,
and do whatever pleases them in it... And the author of this
true story was suffering only because the English, these ultra
monarchists had wished to recognize and support representatives
of Russia of the old, fallen regime, followers of admiral Kol-
chak this traitor to Russia who wished to suppress bolshevism
in Russia with the help of Japan, bolshevism which the ultra

rities in Shanghai opened the doors of the Municipal Jail to

dragoman
Shanghai black judge of the 20th century Imperialist Ivanoff,

The Count dedicated this book to the leader of Socia-
lists maximalists Nicholas Lenin with sincere faithfulness to

Shanghai, Anglo-Chinese Prison, May 1920.
------------------------------------
To the Russian Soviet Government
Moscow.
Owing to plots and intrigues of the former imperial
life-guardsmen and old regime followers: Russian General Con-
sul in Shanghai Herr Grosse, a German and his Vice Consul "real
Russian" Ivanoff for a false visa said to be found during cause
less and unlawful search made at my house in Shanghai, on the
Chinese territory, by the agents of the Russian Consulate...
General Consul Grosse brought me before the Chinese Court,
(Mixed Court in Shanghai) and his Vice Consul Ivanoff senten-
ced me to one year and a half imprisonment in the Anglo-Chi-
page_data.zh:
- 6 -
并揪他们的耳朵！……但他们说，“masky”（音译，可能指“马基”或某种称呼），这些是我们自己的亚洲人，他们也讨厌并害怕英国主子，印度的统治者，也是中国的统治者……至于上海，英国人无疑是那里的主宰，可以为所欲为……而这个真实故事的作者之所以受苦，只是因为英国人，这些极端的君主主义者，希望承认和支持旧俄国、已覆灭政权的代表，即科尔恰克海军上将的追随者，这个叛国贼希望在日本的帮助下镇压俄罗斯的布尔什维克主义，而极端君主制和资产阶级的英国非常害怕布尔什维克主义。由于俄罗斯在上海的代表格罗斯先生和伊万诺夫逮捕并判决伯爵为“布尔什维克”，上海英国当局打开了公共租界监狱的大门接纳他，并根据20世纪帝国主义黑法官伊万诺夫的翻译官（dragoman）的判决，将他这位“危险的俄罗斯革命家”伯爵关押在那里，罪名是在他的文件上发现了一个虚假签证。
伯爵将本书献给社会主义最高纲领派领袖尼古拉·列宁，以表达对俄罗斯人民事业、人类事业的真诚忠诚。
上海，英华监狱，1920年5月。
------------------------------------
致俄罗斯苏维埃政府
莫斯科。
由于前帝国近卫军和旧政权追随者的阴谋和诡计：驻上海俄罗斯总领事格罗斯先生（德国人）和他的副领事“真正的俄罗斯人”伊万诺夫，借口在我位于中国领土上海的家中进行无端且非法的搜查期间发现了虚假签证，搜查由俄罗斯领事馆的代理人执行……总领事格罗斯将我带上中国法庭（上海混合法庭），他的副领事伊万诺夫判处我在英华中

nese prison, me a Russian citizen and Russian officer who had
recently been in military service... Who had left Russia (Har-
bin for China with the permission of military authorities (my
ticket dated December 13, 1917 issued me by the military Com-
mandant of Harbin, Colonel Levitsky with the viza of Popoff,
Russian Consul in Harbin dated December 22, 1917). Besides the
Russian Consulate in Shanghai has my following documents: 1)

那些现在统治俄国的人！
----------
真是耻辱，匈人（Huns）在此势力强大
在俄国领事馆职员和警察队伍中
那些匈人男孩，统治并行事
比非洲祖鲁人更糟！
看看，谁是谁，
身上披着德国皮的人
在此交易和工作
取悦凯撒——最高主宰。
看看并拿定主意
你们英国和美国的朋友
在上海，格罗斯先生（Herr Grosse）、梅兹勒先生（Herr Mezler）、特劳特霍尔德先生（Herr Trautshold），
在哈尔滨，秘密警察首领，冯·阿诺德先生（Herr Von Arnold），
在香港，冯·埃廷根先生（Herr Von Ettingen），一个极端的汪达尔人
在天津，蒂德曼先生（Herr Tiedeman）和盖布罗洛夫斯基将军(?)（Gebrolovsky Gapral(?)）
以及格拉夫先生（Herr Grave），沙皇的宫廷侍从，在北京大使馆官邸
由柏林特别推荐而来……
正如那些匈人承认海军上将高尔察克
这位篡位者，在谢苗诺夫哥萨克的帮助下统治俄国。
还有金钱，如同日本猴子所给
他们想把俄国人当作驴子来驱使
而我们所有的希望现在都寄托在布尔什维克身上
他们将终结那位懦弱的海军上将——蠢货
将叛徒海军上将高尔察克吊在一根好绳子上
如同谢苗诺夫，外贝加尔哥萨克的首领。
